invariants.statement: Default verification neither installs dependencies nor runs live model evals. Passing with reported skips does not qualify skipped capabilities.
Subsystem JSON records are editable current-state routing; index.json is generated. Schemas, code and tests remain underlying authority.
Architecture rules are deterministic constraints; complexity measurements remain advisory and are not acceptance thresholds.
